Our long-term vision is to become the trusted financial partner for millions of Indians.
 
Our Values
Our culture enables us to be what we are — India’s fastest-growing financial services company. It fosters an environment where collaboration, transparency, and open communication take center-stage and hierarchies fade away. There is space for every individual to be themselves and feel motivated to bring their best to the table, as well as craft a promising career for themselves.
The values that form our foundation are:
  • Radical customer centricity
  • Ownership-driven culture
  • Keeping everything simple
  • Long-term thinking
  • Complete transparency

Job Description:

Responsible for research and coverage of high end investment products, this role ensures the firm maintains a live universe of curated investment ideas, supported by data, rationales, and manager intelligence.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Track new product launches across MF, PMS, AIFs, Structured Products.
  • Build and maintain a central repository of data, research, and collaterals.
  • Liaise with asset managers to form house views and provide inputs for product whitelisting.
  • Develop rationales for product approvals to the Investment Committee.
  • Maintain active touchpoints with fund managers, recording insights and updates.
  • Support Wealth Partners with product intelligence and joint calls.

Candidate Requirements:

  • 2-8 years in wealth/product research.
  • Strong analytical and financial writing skills.
  • Understanding of PMS, AIF, and structured products.
  • Relationship management capability with AMCs/fund houses.
  • 2-8 years in wealth/product teams at private banks or AMCs

jobs.title: Credit Risk Analyst
jobs.body: About Us Paytm is India’s leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases.aytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks’ financial instruments. To further enhance merchants’ business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners. About the role: Evangelize and demonstrate the value and impact of analytics for informed business decision making by developing and deploying analytical solutions and providing data driven insights to business stakeholders to understand and solve for various lending business nuances. The Credit Risk Analyst will be responsible for monitoring , analysing and optimising lending portfolios across consumer / merchant lending products. This includes overseeing portfolio health , developing / refining risk strategies and supporting business growth through risk adjusted decision making. Key Responsibilities : - Portfolio Monitoring & Analytics - Risk Strategy & Policy Design - Stress Testing & Risk Containment - Loss forecasting & scenario planning - Product & Growth Partnership - Collections Interface / Strategy - Compliance & Bureau Manageme

Documentation, reporting, and root-cause analysis of prediction issues: owning the problem end to end, not just flagging it. Analyze ingested and system-generated data for anomalies and gaps, and refer to various data sources to plug those gaps. Turn data into stories: surface the pattern behind an issue, propose the fix (QA process-flow change and/or automation), and own the subsequent plan and execution. Automate performance/accuracy review processes, report generation, and data visualization using Python and SQL: building reusable, scalable workflows, not one-off scripts. Support Engineering and Data Science on system-level data fixes. Understand how the engine makes predictions, and explore improvements by fixing or introducing new data and features. Support Customer Operations and Marketing with insights from the data: performance, accuracy metrics, the impact of real-time events, as needed. Maintain and own internal and customer dashboards based on trial/account requirements (prediction accuracy, timeliness, coverage, explainability). Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. At least 2-3+ years in a Data Analyst or Business Analyst role, preferably in a product-based, lean startup particularly in logistics, ecommerce or B2B SaaS data-heavy domain. Exceptionally skilled in Python and SQL, with a demonstrated ability to consistently produce reusable and highly scalable code. An eye for detail: you go looking for anomalies in the system before a customer does, and proven experience turning messy data into clear visualizations. First Principles Thinker: when you explain a past decision, the trade-offs come out before the tools. You name the constraint, the alternatives you considered, and why you picked what you picked. You don't reach for a new tool when a tighter use of an existing one would do the job. Curious by Default: you dig deeper instead of following instructions to the letter. When the data surprises you, you chase the why, not just the fix, and you ask the good questions early. You own your output, AI included. You use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, etc.) where they make you faster on QA, automation, and analysis, and you know exactly where they fall short. You read and validate what they produce — you don't just paste it. You can explain the anomaly, the root cause, and the fix without saying "the AI found it," and you flag AI-assisted work without being asked. We treat AI as a tool that makes good thinking faster, not a shortcut around thinking. Empathy and Urgency: you feel the customer's pain and react promptly on a day-to-day basis (either programmatically or manually) to meet expectations and deliver on time. You communicate nuanced ideas clearly, from real-time remote brainstorming to explaining a data decision in writing. You may be opinionated, but in disagreements you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and can compromise when needed. You have experience working in a diverse, dynamic, and cross-cultural team, with a strong ownership mindset, efficiency, and a data-driven approach. Good to have: a basic understanding of machine learning algorithms. Globally distributed, remote-first flexibility: Work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Our diversity of perspectives fuels innovation and keeps us curious. Data-first team: You'll work with like-minded individuals who share a passion for solving difficult problems with data. Accelerated growth: Compress the learning curve in a couple of years by owning data quality and analytics from day one as your own baby. We are building our company to be the next B2B market leader in predictive global supply chains, and you'll be a major part of our story. Impact you can see: With a lean structure, your work is effective from the start. You'll see the results of your ideas and decisions directly moving the business forward. Curiosity: We read the data before we trust it. We dig into why a number looks the way it does, not just how to make the anomaly disappear. Ownership: We act like founders. We don't wait for someone to flag a data issue, and we stay on a problem until it's actually fixed at the source. Raising the bar: We don't settle for a report that only works this once. We aim for data pipelines and dashboards that are reliable, reusable, and easy for the team to trust. Effectiveness: We focus on analysis that creates real product and customer impact. We prioritize the right problems, make practical trade-offs, and ship work that improves outcomes, not just output.

jobs.source_text: About Lab49 Lab49 is an award-winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology solutions and products for the world's leading financial institutions. Founded in 2002, Lab49 combines strategy, design, and technology expertise to deliver transformative outcomes for investment banks, asset managers, exchanges, and other capital markets participants. Role Overview Lab49 is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented PMO Analyst to support the successful delivery of strategic technology and transformation initiatives. The PMO Analyst will play a key role in driving project governance, integrated planning, reporting, risk management, resource coordination, and delivery controls across complex programs. This role requires strong stakeholder management, analytical skills, and the ability to provide transparency into project performance, dependencies, risks, and milestones while supporting delivery teams and leadership. “ Success in this role means building a PMO that improves delivery outcomes, not simply administering governance activities” Key Responsibilities PMO Capability Building and Operating Model Help design, establish, and mature a scalable PMO operating model covering governance, integrated planning, reporting, financial controls, resource management, risk management, and delivery assurance. Establish common delivery metrics and dashboards that give leadership a clear view of progress, risks, dependencies, capacity, quality, and financial performance. Create reusable playbooks for discovery, mobilization, execution, release readiness, stabilization, and program closure. End-to-End Delivery Management Support delivery from initial discovery and mobilization through planning, execution, release, stabilization, and closure. Maintain an end-to-end view across business, product, design, architecture, engineering, quality engineering, cybersecurity, compliance, and operations. Identify sequencing issues, delivery gaps, conflicting priorities, and cross-team dependencies before they affect critical milestones. Drive ownership of actions and decisions, ensuring unresolved items are escalated with clear impact assessments and recommended options. Conduct delivery health checks, provide an independent evidence-based view of status, and support recovery planning for at-risk workstreams. Coordinate distributed teams and stakeholders across regions, functions, and partner organizations. AI-Enabled Delivery and PMO Use approved AI capabilities to improve the speed and quality of planning, reporting, meeting synthesis, dependency analysis, knowledge retrieval, and management communications. Ensure AI use complies with firm’s confidentiality, data-protection, information-security, and responsible-use requirements. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive PMO activities such as status consolidation, action tracking, document classification, and governance-pack preparation. Governance and Executive Communication Prepare concise executive updates that clearly distinguish progress, risks, decisions required, implications, and recommended actions. Maintain accurate records of decisions, commitments, actions, and escalations. Prepare and maintain governance materials, status reports, steering committee packs, and executive dashboards. Monitor project progress against agreed milestones and provide delivery traceability and reporting. Integrated Planning, Risks, and Dependencies Own or coordinate integrated planning across multiple workstreams and delivery organizations. Establish dependency-management practices that identify upstream and downstream impacts across product, technology, operations, and third parties. Facilitate RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies) management and ensure timely escalation of delivery risks and blockers. Financial, Commercial, and Resource Management Support program budgeting, forecasting, actuals tracking, and variance analysis. Maintain visibility into team capacity, onboarding, allocation, role requirements, and forward demand. Connect resource plans with delivery milestones, critical skills, and workstream priorities. Support commercial tracking across statements of work, deliverables, milestones, change requests, and client commitments. Identify potential scope, timeline, or cost impacts early and support structured change-control discussions. Provide forward-looking views of capacity gaps and delivery constraints rather than relying only on retrospective reporting. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline. 3 to 7 years of experience in PMO, project governance, delivery management, program controls, or related technology-delivery roles. Demonstrated experience independently owning PMO workstreams and building or improving delivery-governance practices within complex technology programs. Experience with RAID management, integrated planning, milestone tracking, dependency management, governance forums, and executive reporting. Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with global stakeholders in a fast-paced consulting environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting technology delivery programs within financial services, capital markets, banking, or fintech organizations. Exposure to Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery methodologies. Experience with financial tracking, resource planning, and executive reporting. PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent project management certifications. What You'll Bring Strong attention to detail and execution excellence. Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Proactive communication and stakeholder management skills. A collaborative mindset with a focus on delivery outcomes. Data-driven decision-making and reporting capabilities. Information Security Responsibilities Comply with all Information Security Management System (ISMS) policies, standards, and procedures. Protect confidential, client, and company information in accordance with Lab49 and ION security requirements. Promptly report security incidents, risks, or policy violations. Participate in mandatory security awareness and compliance training. Ensure adherence to applicable regulatory, contractual, and information security obligations.
